        Engine and version
        
              The engine here leaves out the precomputed analyses lift, relative_risk, uniformity and ratios: they need several GB, more than a browser tab is given. Add ?engine=full to the address to build them on a machine with the memory; the terminal command has them. The first query using query_similarity downloads the SPECTER2 query model and the embeddings of the studies, about 310 MB.
              
        
              Neurosynth + tracts (?engine=neurosynth_iit) adds to the studies of Neurosynth the whole-brain tractogram of the IIT Human Brain Atlas v3, 15,000 of its 37,980 streamlines chosen at random and thinned, indexed by the atlas's Desikan–Killiany wmparc (labels of FreeSurfer's colour LUT), and tract_querier's bundles (uf, af, cst…) as Datalog rules. The tractogram and the wmparc are those of the IIT Human Brain Atlas (Illinois Institute of Technology; Qi, Arfanakis et al.), under the IIT Human Brain Template License (non-commercial educational and research use, with attribution); the colour LUT is FreeSurfer's.

              Technical details
              
    
              
    
              
      
              
        
              
        
              The first start takes about 30 s: it loads Python, the engine and its data (Neurosynth, Neurosynth + tracts or NeuroStore, as the selector at the top says), which the browser keeps for the next visit.
              
      
              
      
              
        
              Run a query to see its answer here
              
        
              Pick one of the examples, or write your own query. The answer comes as a table. Brain shows its regions and studies on the brain, and Graph shows where it comes from.
